comparison.objective: Replace failed and predictive-failure drives in the safe order while preserving a RAID array.
comparison.physical_skill: Top-loading drive extraction/insertion with state-dependent waiting and sequencing.
comparison.success_condition: Failed drive is replaced first, rebuild is awaited, then the amber drive is replaced; premature or wrong removal loses the array.
comparison.reason: Tests ordered hot swapping and system-state monitoring, not bimanual hammer/mandrel coordination or fracture-product containment.
